disposition_reason: Table 1 reports cadmium, lead and mercury in rapeseed meal before and after fermentation, all below quantification limits.

study.lod_text: Methods: Hg LOD 0.02 mg/kg, Cd 0.003 mg/kg, Pb 0.001 mg/kg; Table 1 LOQs: Cd 0.003, Pb 0.020, Hg 0.001 mg/kg

unresolved: Metals were measured only in the rapeseed meal ingredient before and after fermentation, not in the veggie burgers themselves.
Limit conflict: methods give Hg 0.02 mg/kg and Pb 0.001 mg/kg, while Table 1 prints Pb <0.020 and Hg <0.001 mg/kg, suggesting the Pb and Hg limits are swapped in one place.
